Subject: Post-call: IAM & SOC 2 follow-up / next steps

Hi Jane / Carlos 

Thanks again for the call earlier 

great to meet your security and infra team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope (can provide a redacted report).
- You flagged two immediate items for your procurement/security review: SSO/SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning details, and our RBAC/admin controls matrix.
- Next steps I propose:
  1) We'll upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II report for your review (ETA: 3 business days).
  2) Marissa (SE) will share an IAM evidence worksheet with SAML/SCIM endpoints, recommended claims, and how RBAC maps to our console roles.
  3) If you prefer, we can complete a short vendor security questionnaire (we've done these in DocuSign/Google Forms before) 

I've attached our IAM evidence request template to speed up exchange of artifacts. Please let us know if you want a short follow-up call this week to walk through the metadata exchange and test a SAML assertion.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Aditya 

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement will need a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine). We typically require the last 12 months.
- Security needs SAML metadata (IdP/SP XML) and SCIM endpoint + sample provisioning payloads.
- We also use a standard vendor security questionnaire (VSA) 

Could you confirm what RBAC roles map to the following: Admin (full org access), Billing Admin, Read-only Analyst?

If you can get the SOC report and the IAM worksheet to us by EOD Friday (30 Jul), we can move this forward on our side that week.

Jane

Hi Jane 

Following up with the IAM details for your security team's checklist. I've attached our IAM evidence worksheet (spreadsheet) 
 it contains the SAML/SCIM endpoints, example SAML metadata, claim mappings, and an RBAC matrix that maps our console roles to the three roles you mentioned. Highlights: 

- SSO / SAML (SP-initiated):
  * ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) URL: https://login.redwood.ai/saml/acs
  * Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp:prod
  * Requested attributes: email, firstName, lastName, groups
  * Suggested NameID: emailAddress

- SCIM provisioning:
  * Provisioning endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users
  * Auth: Bearer token (we'll create a scoped token per customer)
  * Supported operations: Create, Replace, Patch, Delete, Search

- RBAC mapping (summary):
  * Admin = Organization Admin (full access to org, billing, user management)
  * Billing Admin = Billing Manager (invoice/plan access, cannot change org-level security settings)
  * Read-only Analyst = Viewer (can read routes, logs, usage, cannot edit models or configs)

Attachments: redwood_iam_evidence_request_20270728.xlsx (filled)

If you want, we can spin up a short Zoom with one of our engineers to do the SAML metadata exchange and validate an assertion. I'm available Thu afternoon (30 Jul) and Fri morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
